name: Practice session minute planner
why: Breaks one skill into timed 5 to 12 minute blocks with what to watch for and what to say, a quick start before the full session plan builder.

name: Skill breakdown teaching planner
why: Splits a sport skill into learning steps with a common mistake and a self-check for each, useful when writing coaching points.

name: Check a lesson before teaching it
why: Checks a planned session for overload and adds quick checks of understanding, a second pair of eyes before a volunteer runs it.

name: Adapt a lesson for different access needs
why: Finds what blocks players with access needs and offers other ways to take part, alongside the easier and harder drill versions.

name: Task rubric drafter
why: Drafts clear level wording for each skill, a starting point for the progress sheet levels.

name: Build a volunteer induction checklist
why: Turns the club's roles and safeguarding rules into an induction checklist with sign-offs for new volunteer coaches.

name: Volunteer induction evidence review assistant
why: Checks each volunteer's induction records against their role and lists gaps; a named person still signs off, as the handbook expects.

name: Make a new policy understandable to staff
why: Explains a new club policy, such as a concussion or messaging rule, in plain words to volunteer coaches.

name: Feedback conversation planner
why: Plans a calm, specific conversation with a parent helper or assistant coach about a problem at training.

name: Dull update email rewriter
why: Sharpens a flat club update so parents read it and act, for newsletters beyond the standard messages.
